additional_concerns: The advertising claim's uncertainty is stale: footnote 4 and the subsequent advertising paragraph are supplied. Footnote 4 incorporates FAQs and other SFC guidance; those external materials and the Advertising Guidelines themselves are absent.

The external Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and the answer to question 1 of the SFC's 30 September 2010 Code of Conduct FAQs are absent. The circular supports the stated gift rule, but does not establish every substantive gift or discount classification.

For node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e, placing component_offered_to_client in Scope returns OUT_OF_SCOPE when no offer exists, rather than FALSE for a component that is not caught. Preserve this distinction for the typed question.

For node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f, node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6, placing the promotional link in Scope returns OUT_OF_SCOPE when that link is false. Repeating the predicate in Result does not restore the typed negative answer.

For node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5, compliance is assessed only within linked promotion. An unlinked benefit returns OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than TRUE; the intended treatment of such benefits under the selected control remains to be specified.

The offer-level candidates combine an offer-level promotional link with an existential non-discount gift fact. They do not expressly require that the same gift component has the qualifying promotional link. A mixed offer could therefore be overclassified unless supplied classifications establish that connection.

The SFC-authorised-fund limitation follows the circular's introductory scope, but the quoted paragraph 3.11 describes investment products generally. Preserve the distinction between this circular's application and the full reach of the underlying Code.

Neither absence of a caught gift nor compliance with this selected gift control establishes compliance with section 103 or the advertising requirements. Conversely, SFC authorisation or a statutory exemption does not establish an exception to the gift restriction.
The supplied material does not establish a concrete effective-date interval. The candidates' temporal convention cannot independently establish applicability at a particular historical time.
